additional_context: The seed's related URL is an archived 2015May publication rather than current build source. FHIR-7785 is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The historical root cause was fixed in source history, and current generated TOC evidence shows Patient, Questionnaire, Organization, Location, ValueSet, and Condition linking to their main resource-content pages instead of extension or subordinate pages.
